newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA says in gaming alliances talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA says in gaming alliances talks.

text.p: Electronics and gaming operator AWA Ltd said on Thursday it has held talks with international gaming, wagering and entertainment groups to form possible alliances.

"Strong alliances are being pursued to add further value, and we have been holding discussions with a number of major international gaming, wagering and entertainment companies," chairman John Iliffe said in a letter to shareholders.
Two weeks ago, AWA reported a loss of A$14.26 million for the year to June 30 and announced that John Rouse would replace managing director John Dougall.

"We have the capabilities, or certainly have the ability to build and acquire the capabilities, to achieve sustainable competitive advantage and to create growth in shareholder value in entertainment and communications," Iliffe said.
"I firmly believe that Mr Rouse will succeed in implementing this strategy and look forward to reporting to you in future on the achievements of the company," he said.
AWA shares closed two cents higher at 93 cents.
